FROM store.pos_lines
WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
  AND sku_scanned IN ('ATTA-WW-1KG','ATTA-WW-10KG','ATTA-WW-5KG')
  AND date(bill_ts)::date IN ('2026-06-12','2026-06-23','2026-06-24','2026-06-25','2026-06-26','2026-06-27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2;

WITH ss AS (
  SELECT d.date, d.units_sold, d.revenue_inr, f.forecast_units_per_day, f.book_on_hand, b.book_on_hand_close
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku=d.sku AND f.date=d.date
  JOIN store.inventory_book b ON b.sku=d.sku AND b.date=d.date
  WHERE d.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT s.date, s.units_sold, s.forecast_units_per_day, s.book_on_hand, s.book_on_hand_close,
       (s.forecast_units_per_day - s.units_sold) AS shortfall_units,
       round((s.forecast_units_per_day - s.units_sold)*265.0,2) AS shortfall_inr,
       (SELECT status FROM store.shelf_audits a WHERE a.sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND a.audit_ts::date=s.date) AS audit
FROM ss s ORDER BY s.date;
